```{=html}
<div id="demo-1d" style="font-family: monospace; user-select: none;">
  <style>
    #demo-1d {
      outline: none;
    }
    #demo-1d .demo-section-label {
      font-size: 0.45em;
      color: #999;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    #demo-1d canvas {
      display: block;
      margin: 0 auto;
      image-rendering: pixelated;
    }
    #demo-1d .controls-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 14px;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    #demo-1d .ctrl-btn {
      padding: 5px 18px;
      font-size: 0.55em;
      font-family: monospace;
      border: 1.5px solid #555;
      background: #1a1a1a;
      color: #ddd;
      border-radius: 4px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.1s;
    }
    #demo-1d .ctrl-btn:hover { background: #2e2e2e; }
    #demo-1d .ctrl-btn:active, #demo-1d .ctrl-btn.pressed { background: #444; border-color: #aaa; }
    #demo-1d .ctrl-btn.active { background: #1B5E20; border-color: #66BB6A; color: #A5D6A7; }
    #demo-1d .divider { width: 1px; height: 22px; background: #444; margin: 0 6px; }
    #demo-1d .info-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 30px;
      margin-top: 8px;
      font-size: 0.45em;
      color: #bbb;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    #demo-1d .info-row span b { color: #fff; }
    #demo-1d .perception-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 3px;
      margin-top: 6px;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: flex-end;
    }
    #demo-1d .p-cell {
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 0.5em; color: #eee; font-weight: bold;
      border: 1.5px solid #444;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- World canvas -->
  <div style="text-align:center;">
    <div class="demo-section-label">Середовище W (N=50)</div>
    <canvas id="world-canvas" width="1400" height="28"></canvas>
  </div>

  <!-- Perception -->
  <div style="text-align:center; margin-top:14px;">
    <div class="demo-section-label">Сприйняття o (radius=3)</div>
    <div class="perception-row" id="perc-cells"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- Info row -->
  <div class="info-row">
    <span>Позиція: <b id="info-pos">10</b></span>
    <span>Крок: <b id="info-step">0</b></span>
    <span id="info-dynamic-label" style="color:#66BB6A; display:none;">● Правило 30</span>
  </div>

  <!-- Controls -->
  <div class="controls-row">
    <button class="ctrl-btn" id="btn-left"  onclick="demoAct('left')">← (A / ←)</button>
    <button class="ctrl-btn" id="btn-stay"  onclick="demoAct('stay')">● (S)</button>
    <button class="ctrl-btn" id="btn-right" onclick="demoAct('right')">→ (D / →)</button>
    <div class="divider"></div>
    <button class="ctrl-btn" id="btn-dynamic" onclick="demoToggleDynamic()">⚡ Динамічне (Правило 30)</button>
    <div class="divider"></div>
    <button class="ctrl-btn" onclick="demoReset()">↺ Reset</button>
    <span style="font-size:0.38em; color:#555; margin-left:10px;">← A &nbsp;·&nbsp; S &nbsp;·&nbsp; D →</span>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  const N = 50, R = 3;
  const CELL_W = 28, CELL_H = 28;
  const RULE30 = 30;

  // World state
  let rng = mulberry32(42);
  let world = Array.from({length: N}, () => Math.round(rng()));
  let agentPos = 10;
  let step = 0;
  let dynamic = false;
  let dynInterval = null;

  function mulberry32(seed) {
    return function() {
      seed |= 0; seed = seed + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
      let t = Math.imul(seed ^ seed >>> 15, 1 | seed);
      t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  function getPerception(pos) {
    let p = [];
    for (let i = -R; i <= R; i++) {
      p.push(world[((pos + i) % N + N) % N]);
    }
    return p;
  }

  function rule30Step() {
    const next = new Array(N);
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      const l = world[(i - 1 + N) % N];
      const c = world[i];
      const r = world[(i + 1) % N];
      const idx = (l << 2) | (c << 1) | r;
      next[i] = (RULE30 >> idx) & 1;
    }
    world = next;
  }

  function drawWorld() {
    const canvas = document.getElementById('world-canvas');
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      const x = i * CELL_W;
      const dist = Math.min((i - agentPos + N) % N, (agentPos - i + N) % N);

      if (i === agentPos) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#E64A19';
      } else if (dist <= R) {
        ctx.fillStyle = world[i] === 1 ? '#90CAF9' : '#1a3a5c';
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = world[i] === 1 ? '#e0e0e0' : '#1a1a1a';
      }
      ctx.fillRect(x, 0, CELL_W - 1, CELL_H);

      // Agent marker
      if (i === agentPos) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.font = 'bold 11px monospace';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('A', x + CELL_W / 2, CELL_H / 2 + 4);
      }
    }
    // Perception bracket
    if (agentPos - R >= 0 && agentPos + R < N) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#90CAF9';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      const lx = (agentPos - R) * CELL_W;
      const rx = (agentPos + R + 1) * CELL_W - 1;
      ctx.strokeRect(lx, 1, rx - lx, CELL_H - 2);
    }
  }

  function drawPerception(perc) {
    const el = document.getElementById('perc-cells');
    if (!el) return;
    el.innerHTML = '';
    perc.forEach((v, i) => {
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'p-cell';
      if (i === R) {
        div.style.background = '#E64A19';
        div.style.borderColor = '#E64A19';
      } else {
        div.style.background = v === 1 ? '#eee' : '#222';
        div.style.color = v === 1 ? '#111' : '#777';
      }
      div.textContent = v;
      el.appendChild(div);
    });
  }

  function updateInfo() {
    document.getElementById('info-pos').textContent = agentPos;
    document.getElementById('info-step').textContent = step;
    document.getElementById('info-dynamic-label').style.display = dynamic ? 'inline' : 'none';
  }

  function render() {
    drawWorld();
    drawPerception(getPerception(agentPos));
    updateInfo();
  }

  window.demoAct = function(action) {
    if (action === 'left')  agentPos = (agentPos - 1 + N) % N;
    if (action === 'right') agentPos = (agentPos + 1) % N;
    step++;
    const btnMap = {left: 'btn-left', right: 'btn-right', stay: 'btn-stay'};
    const btn = document.getElementById(btnMap[action]);
    if (btn) { btn.classList.add('pressed'); setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('pressed'), 150); }
    render();
  };

  window.demoToggleDynamic = function() {
    dynamic = !dynamic;
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn-dynamic');
    if (dynamic) {
      btn.classList.add('active');
      dynInterval = setInterval(() => { rule30Step(); step++; render(); }, 300);
    } else {
      btn.classList.remove('active');
      clearInterval(dynInterval);
      dynInterval = null;
    }
    updateInfo();
  };

  window.demoReset = function() {
    if (dynInterval) { clearInterval(dynInterval); dynInterval = null; }
    dynamic = false;
    document.getElementById('btn-dynamic').classList.remove('active');
    rng = mulberry32(42);
    world = Array.from({length: N}, () => Math.round(rng()));
    agentPos = 10; step = 0;
    render();
  };

  // Keyboard support — listen on document, only when slide is visible
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    // Don't hijack if user is typing somewhere
    if (e.target && e.target.tagName === 'INPUT') return;
    if (e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  { e.stopPropagation(); demoAct('left'); }
    if (e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') { e.stopPropagation(); demoAct('right'); }
    if (e.key === 's') demoAct('stay');
  }, true);

  // Init
  render();
})();
</script>
```
